sections.heading: The league gives students a reason to show up every week.
sections.headingHtml: The league gives students a reason to show up every week.
sections.lede: A lot of esports programs stall after the ribbon cutting. Players drift into casual play, interest fades, and the room goes quiet.
body: We’ve spent years building esports spaces, and we built the League so they get used. It adds the part that’s usually missing: scheduled matches against real opponents, with standings, playoffs, and a championship night at the end.
Players get opponents. Coaches get structure. Leaders get results they can point to, season after season.

faqs.q: Is the League free to join?
faqs.a: No. The League is a paid, fully managed program. Pricing depends on your number of teams, titles, format, and whether you host the finals. Contact us and we’ll put together a quote for your program.

faqs.q: Do we need a TANCHES.GG-built facility to participate?
faqs.a: No. The League is open to any program with its own esports space. Programs that build their facility with TANCHES.GG get discounted League pricing, so your build and your first season work together from day one.

It depends on your program. K-12 seasons run an 8-week regular season, 2 weeks of playoffs, and a championship night, aligned to the school calendar. For community, healthcare, and commercial programs, we build the schedule and format around how your organization actually operates.
Education divisions play established scholastic titles such as VALORANT, Rocket League, Overwatch 2, and Mario Kart 8. Community and commercial formats are chosen with you to fit your players.

faqs.q: What happens if a team misses a match?
faqs.a: Match times are required. A no-show is a forfeit, and repeated no-shows can lead to disqualification. Real stakes are what keep players invested.

faqs.q: Can multiple locations join as one program?
faqs.a: Yes. The League scales from a single site to a network of locations, a region, or a nationwide format.
Member programs, whether a campus, a community center, or a venue, can host the finals on-site. We handle the format and run of show.

faqs.q: How do players and coaches follow the season?
faqs.a: Members get portal access for schedules, rosters, results, and standings throughout the season.
